interactions.conditions: Post-fix board-a topology routes J1.A5/J1.B5 directly to STUSB4500 U1.2/U1.4 with 0-ohm R19/R20 jumpers into the debounce nets, DNP R17/R18 Rd provisions (STUSB4500 presents its internal Rd) and DNP D6/D7 ESD provisions; PD negotiation requires intact CC continuity through the receptacle — continuity-map both CC pads with no cable and both plug orientations on the dead v4 boards before any board-a order

J1.A9/J1.B9 feed VBUS_IN shared with U1 VBUS sense/discharge, C1 10 uF and C2 100 nF decoupling, D5 SMAJ20A 20 V-standoff TVS, R14 470-ohm discharge path, Q1 load-switch input and R11 VBEN divider; the negotiated 15 V / 3 A contract exceeds the mirror-stated 5 V rating and uses the full 3 A rating — verify thermal and contact behavior at 15 V on the bench
